Kishor Kumar Kar @ Kishor Kar vs State Of Odisha And Others
..... ... on 15 March, 2024

Bench: B.R. Sarangi, G.Satapathy
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 W.P.(C) No.6108 of 2024
Kishor Kumar Kar @ Kishor Kar ..... Petitioner
 Mr. P.K. Behera, Advocate
 Vs.
State of Odisha and others .....

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 State Counsel
 Coram:
 Dr.Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice G.Satapathy
 Order
15.03.2024 Order No.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3.

According to Mr. Behera, the petitioner is aggrieved by the non-disposal of his application filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 styled as L.A. Misc. Case No.20 of 2020 arising out of L.A.C. No.06 of 2012 pending before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Upper Indravati irrigation Project, Kalahandi (Opposite Party No.3).
In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to the Opposite Party No.3 to dispose of the said case expeditiously.

4. Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court disposes of the writ petition directing the Opposite Party No.3 to dispose of the L.A. Misc.
Case No.20 of 2020 arising out of L.A. Case No.06 of 2012 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner.

It is further directed that in case the application of the petitioner under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is allowed, and if there is no other legal impediment, the compensation amount be disbursed in favour of the petitioner within a period of two months thereafter.
5. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
